topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
source_evidence: A no-load mutual fund does not charge any type of sales load. But no-load does not mean no fees.
question: Does “no-load” mean a mutual fund has no fees at all?
answer: No. “No-load” means the fund does not charge a sales load. It may still charge other fees, such as purchase, redemption, exchange, or account fees, so check the fund’s fee information to see what charges apply.
